groups.activity: pledge Steel Meridian, earn standing from mission affinity and Syndicate Medallions
groups.meta: 340,000 standing total to General plus the pistol
groups.mode: leave around round 8 for one clean daily cap

rows.label: Aya
rows.note: 2 at Rank 4 Protector, 3 at Rank 5 General

conditions: Daily standing cap is 16,000 plus 500 per Mastery Rank, shared across every faction syndicate, resetting 00:00 UTC.
Pledging Steel Meridian costs The Perrin Sequence 100% and New Loka 50% of every gain.
Rank-ups also cost 940,000 credits in total. Standing stops at a rank's maximum until you rank up, so waiting on Aya throws daily standing away.
bonuses: The three daily Steel Meridian Syndicate Alerts and their Insignias (8 per alert, roughly 10,000 standing) ignore the daily cap. Cap on affinity first, then turn the Insignias in.
An Affinity Booster doubles pledge standing.
Steel Meridian feeds Red Veil at +50% and leaves Suda and Arbiters of Hexis untouched.

disclosures.title: why 340,000
disclosures.body: 240,000 standing carries the five rank-ups to General (5,000 / 22,000 / 44,000 / 70,000 / 99,000). The 100,000-standing purchase is then farmed on top.

disclosures.title: long Duviri runs drain opposed syndicates
disclosures.body: When the pledged bar is full for its rank but the daily cap isn't reached, the loss applied to Perrin and New Loka can keep going far past normal; players report 70k to 200k lost in one long run. Rank up or spend before a long run.

conditions: The free item you pick at General can never be a Syndicate weapon; the Marelok is always a separate 100,000-standing purchase.
Mastery Rank 10 is required both to buy it and to receive it in a trade.
bonuses: Vaykor Hek and Vaykor Sydon sell from the same General rank if you want all the Steel Meridian Mastery.
